rows.text: returns 1 when bit `ecx` of the bit array at `0209A2A0` is set (byte `ecx / 8` and bit `ecx % 8`, both by signed division rounding toward zero) and 0 when it is clear

takes the 64-byte record indexed by the zero-extended `cl` in the array at qword `02B47790` and, only when its dword `+4` equals the full `ecx`, replaces bit 7 of its byte `+1` with bit 0 of `dl` (AND `0x7F`, then OR `dl` shifted left by 7); otherwise it writes nothing

returns 0 when `rdx` is null; otherwise passes `rdx` to the call at `00422FD0` + 0x18 and its result, with 0 when `r8d AND 0xF000` is `0x5000` and `r8d AND 0xFFF` otherwise, to the call at `00422FD0` + 0x3C, and returns 1 only when that second result is non-null, dword `rcx+0x284` has bit `0x10000` set and the second result's dword `+4` has a bit of `0x30000` set, else 0

notes: 00422FD0: the two callees are not named in the host excerpt, so both calls are cited by site. 0025C130: for a negative ecx the remainder is negative and the shift count comes from it as the listing computes (cdq/and 7/sar 3); the sentence states the signed-division form.
